## Context

`AGENTS.md` §"Navigating the codebase (when editing rebar itself)" describes the Serena
MCP server as operating over "this checkout". That is no longer accurate on the operator's
host: Serena has been re-pointed at a dedicated, filesystem-read-only clone that tracks
`origin/main` and is refreshed by a `StartInterval=3600` LaunchAgent (the same shape as the
existing `com.navapbc.rebar-dev-update` agent).

Two consequences follow that an agent reading `AGENTS.md` cannot infer, and that silently
produce wrong conclusions:

1. Serena's view is a snapshot of `origin/main`, refreshed on a poll interval, so it can
   trail current `main` by up to that interval.
2. It therefore never contains uncommitted work sitting in the worktree the agent is
   actually editing.

An agent that assumes Serena indexes its own worktree will read a stale or absent symbol
and conclude the code does not exist.

## Approach

Append ONE short paragraph to the existing §"Navigating the codebase" section of
`AGENTS.md`, immediately after the closing "Cross-cutting change → do **both**…" paragraph.
It states only (a) Serena reads a read-only mirror of `origin/main` rather than the local
checkout, and (b) that mirror auto-updates on a lag, so its answers can trail `main` and
will not show uncommitted worktree work.

Prose only, in the surrounding voice and bold-emphasis style. No table row is added; the
existing table is about Serena-vs-grep failure modes, which this is not.

## Scope

IN scope: the mirror fact and the staleness expectation, in `AGENTS.md` only.

OUT of scope, deliberately, and must NOT appear in the change:
- any warning about Serena's edit tools or write hazards
- worktree isolation guidance
- how the mirror or its LaunchAgent is built, located, or operated (machine-local, and
  `CLAUDE.local.md` / `docs/*.local.md` are git-ignored — this repo change carries no
  host-specific paths)
- edits to `docs/code-navigation.md` or any other file

## Portability

Documentation-only prose in a checked-in guidance file. It adds no code path, no command,
no CI trigger, and no dependency on any CI provider, scheduler, or host service. The
guidance is written host-agnostically ("a read-only mirror of `origin/main`", "a poll
interval") so it is equally true for any environment that points Serena at a mirror, and
harmless where Serena is absent — that case is already covered by the section's existing
`claude mcp get serena` pointer. Nothing in it can fail to trigger, because nothing in it
triggers.

## Acceptance Criteria

Every proof below is SECTION-SCOPED via the `awk` range over §"Navigating the codebase",
because each of these strings already occurs ELSEWHERE in `AGENTS.md` — measured on the
pre-edit file: `read-only mirror` once (line 373, GitHub as a read-only mirror of Gerrit),
`uncommitted` once (line 447, operator WIP), and `trail` as a substring of `trailer` six
times. A file-wide `grep -c … == 1` would therefore be unsatisfiable or false. Inside the
section all three counts are `0` before the edit, so `== 1` after it is a sound proof that
this paragraph, and only this paragraph, introduced them.

All six were run against the landed change (merged as `ae203145fa39a153c21b6cba8b25cb5679849ec9`).

- [x] The Serena section of `AGENTS.md` states that Serena reads a read-only mirror of
      `origin/main` rather than the local checkout.
      Proof: `awk '/^## Navigating the codebase/,/^## Git workflow/' AGENTS.md | grep -c 'read-only mirror'`
      prints `1` (it prints `0` on the pre-edit file). OBSERVED: `1`.
- [x] The same paragraph states that Serena's answers can trail current `main`.
      Proof: `awk '/^## Navigating the codebase/,/^## Git workflow/' AGENTS.md | grep -cw 'trail'`
      prints `1` (it prints `0` on the pre-edit file). `-w` is required: `trail` is a
      substring of the many pre-existing `trailer` mentions. OBSERVED: `1`.
- [x] The same paragraph states that the mirror does not include uncommitted worktree work.
      Proof: `awk '/^## Navigating the codebase/,/^## Git workflow/' AGENTS.md | grep -cw 'uncommitted'`
      prints `1` (it prints `0` on the pre-edit file). OBSERVED: `1`.
- [x] No file other than `AGENTS.md` is modified.
      Proof: `git diff --name-only origin/main` prints exactly the single line `AGENTS.md`.
      OBSERVED: `AGENTS.md`, and nothing else.
- [x] The change is additions only, so no existing guidance was reworded or removed.
      Proof: `git diff --numstat origin/main -- AGENTS.md` reports `0` in the deletions
      column. OBSERVED: `4	0	AGENTS.md`.
- [x] Out-of-scope topics are absent: the addition names neither Serena's edit tools, nor
      write/edit hazards, nor worktree isolation, nor any host-specific path or LaunchAgent.
      Proof: `git diff origin/main -- AGENTS.md | grep -icE 'replace_symbol|insert_after|edit tool|launchagent|/Users/'`
      prints `0`. OBSERVED: `0`.

## Testing

This change is documentation prose, so it carries no unit test; it is proven by the
acceptance-criteria commands above plus the repository's standing gates, all run from the
change's own worktree before push:

- `make lint` — ruff check + format-check (the commit gate). RAN: exit 0.
- `make typecheck` — mypy. RAN: exit 0, "no issues found in 683 source files".
- `pytest tests/unit/test_module_size_contract.py` — the module-size contract. This is a
  CI-only gate that `make lint` does NOT run, so it is run explicitly. RAN: 4 passed.
- `python scripts/check_complexity_baseline.py --check` — the shrink-only complexity
  ratchet. RAN: `active=39 new=0 increased=0 stale=10`.

A prose-only change cannot regress any of the four, so a failure in any of them is
evidence the diff touched more than `AGENTS.md` and must be investigated before push, not
retried.

Final verification is the Gerrit gate itself: the change is not landed until it carries
`LLM-Review +1` and `Verified +1` (CI green on GitHub Actions) with no unresolved comments.
Gerrit change 2343 reached `LLM-Review +1`, `Verified +1`, `unresolved_comment_count 0`,
and merged as `ae203145fa39a153c21b6cba8b25cb5679849ec9`.

## Definition of done

- [x] `AGENTS.md` edited as above; every acceptance criterion verified by running its
      stated proof command and observing the stated output.
- [x] All four commands in `## Testing` run and pass.
- [x] Change pushed to `refs/for/main`, carries `LLM-Review +1` and `Verified +1`, no
      unresolved comments, and is submitted/merged (Gerrit 2343).

## File impact

- `AGENTS.md` — append one paragraph to the "Navigating the codebase" section.
